reviews.author: Abhijith Drummer
reviews.text: I recently completed an online digital marketing course taught by Melvin and Sarun, and it was a fantastic experience! Both instructors were highly knowledgeable and engaging, making complex topics easy to understand. They provided practical hands-on assignments, and up-to-date insights into the digital marketing industry. I particularly appreciated their willingness to answer questions and offer personalized feedback. This course has boosted my confidence and skills significantly. Highly recommend it to anyone looking to dive into digital marketing!

reviews.author: Parvathy Vijayan
reviews.text: Thank you golden cube team… Shalu for giving me insights on video making and using meta ai and chat GPT for description, Sarun Stani for the valuable lessons of FB & IG and helping me in running campaigns and patiently listening to my doubts and clearing them, Melvin Edward for the cheerful class on LinkedIn which I was least familiar to. Thanking the whole team…. It was a wonderful experience… I recommend golden cube for digital independence….

reviews.author: Jithin Abraham
reviews.text: I am writing to extend my sincere appreciation for the exceptional Digital Marketing training I had at Golden Qube Digital Academy. The depth of knowledge, practical insights, and hands-on experience provided during the training were truly invaluable. A special mention must go to the trainers—Shalu, Melwin, and Sarun—whose expertise and dedication to teaching were evident throughout the course. Thanks to their guidance, I now feel more confident and equipped to implement digital marketing strategies effectively.
